title: Steering Away from Memorization: Reachability-Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Text-to-Image Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2603.00140v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models are susceptible to memorization, revealing a fundamental failure to generalize beyond the training set. Current mitigation approaches often sacrifice image quality or prompt alignment to reduce memorization. To address this, we propose Reachability-Aware Diffusion Steering (RADS), an offline-trained, sampling-time control framework that mitigates memorization while maintaining generation fidelity. RADS models the diffusion denoising process as a dynamical system and learns a policy-conditioned reachability value function that estimates future memorization risk along the denoising trajectory. This motivates a constrained reinforcement learning (RL) formulation, where a policy learns to steer the trajectory away from memorization via perturbations in the caption embedding space. translated_title: 偏离记忆化：面向文本到图像扩散的可达性约束强化学习
translated_abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型容易发生记忆化现象，这暴露了其在训练集之外泛化能力的根本性缺陷。当前的缓解方法通常需要牺牲图像质量或提示词对齐来减少记忆化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了可达性感知扩散引导（Reachability-Aware Diffusion Steering, RADS），这是一个离线训练、在采样时进行控制的框架，能够在保持生成保真度的同时减轻记忆化。RADS将扩散去噪过程建模为一个动力系统，并学习一个策略条件下的可达性价值函数，用于估计去噪轨迹上未来的记忆化风险。由此引出一种约束强化学习（RL）的公式化表述，其中策略通过在标题嵌入空间中的扰动来学习引导轨迹远离记忆化。实证评估表明，RADS在生成多样性（SSCD）与图像质量之间实现了更强的经验帕累托前沿。
tldr: 该论文提出RADS框架，将扩散去噪过程建模为动力系统，并利用离线训练的约束强化学习在采样时通过标题嵌入扰动引导轨迹远离记忆化，从而在缓解文本到图像扩散模型记忆化的同时保持生成保真度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RADS, an offline-trained sampling-time control framework that models denoising as a dynamical system and employs constrained reinforcement learning to steer trajectories away from memorization via caption embedding perturbations, mitigating memorization in text-to-image diffusion while preserving generation fidelity.
